# Constructor

## toPrice
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/price-utils/contracts/Constructor.sol)

Creates a Price type from a base and quote amount


```solidity
function toPrice(uint256 baseAmount, uint256 quoteAmount) pure returns (Price memory);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`baseAmount`|`uint256`|The amount of the base asset with the given decimals|
|`quoteAmount`|`uint256`|The amount of the quote asset with the given decimals|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`Price`|The resulting Price type|




## toPriceFromOraclePrice
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/price-utils/contracts/Constructor.sol)

Creates a Price type from an oracle price


```solidity
function toPriceFromOraclePrice(
uint256 baseAmount,
int256 oraclePrice,
uint8 oracleDecimals,
uint8 quoteDecimals
)
pure
returns (Price memory);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`baseAmount`|`uint256`|The amount of the base asset|
|`oraclePrice`|`int256`|The price from the oracle|
|`oracleDecimals`|`uint8`|The decimals of the oracle|
|`quoteDecimals`|`uint8`|The decimals of the quote asset|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`Price`|The resulting Price type|
